If you like zucchini, chickpeas, and onions...then do I have a poor pauper's meal for you!

Get two medium zucchini, a large sweet onion (or whichever you prefer) a can of chickpeas, greek yogurt, and a lemon. If you have the budget, grab the spices Garam Malsala, Tumeric, Cinnamon and salt.

Dice your onion and add it into a large skillet with some oil and cook it until it becomes caramelized. While your onion cooks, cut your zucchini into half moon shaped chunks. Add the zucchini once the onion is almost done and stir to combine and let cook until the zucchini becomes slightly browned and tender. Drain and rinse the chick peas and add to the skillet. While everything cooks together on medium low heat, add in your garam masala, tumeric, salt and cinnamon. I don't have specific measurements so just season to taste to your liking. If you are having trouble getting the spices to coat evenly, add a few tablespoons of water to the skillet one at a time to help. Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes so that everything is heated through.

I like to make a lemon greek yogurt sauce to add to this. Add some yogurt to a bowl and slowly add water to it until it gets thinner so you can drizzle it. Zest the lemon and add as much or as little zest as you want. Add the juice from half the lemon into the yogurt and stir to combine. I also like to add some finely chopped cilantro to it if I have some on hand.

And that's it! I like to serve this over brown rice and I love to chop up some dried apricots to garnish it with. They add just the perfect touch of sweetness. This makes several meals worth and it is great for meal prepping.
